description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, operating since 2005 with 385+ locations, and this Colwood outpost serves customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made to order. It is a fast-casual counter-service restaurant with online ordering and third-party delivery available. A touring cyclist stopping in the Colwood/Langford corridor will find a quick, filling meal with a wide range of protein and dietary options.

address.value: Unit 100, 1903 Sooke Rd, Colwood, British Columbia V9B 1V0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the Colwood/Victoria location confirms BarBurrito is open and operating at Unit 100, 1903 Sooke Rd, Colwood, BC — the phone number 250-590-4473 matches OSM. A unit number discrepancy exists: OSM tags show addr:unit=104 while the website shows Unit 100. The menu page confirms vegetarian and gluten-free options; takeout is confirmed via online ordering, SkipTheDishes, and Uber Eats. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill was found in the website content.
